script.name: Link save folder into the service root
script.description: Points the service user's LOCALAPPDATA\FactoryGame\Saved\SaveGames at FactoryGame\Saved\SaveGames in the service root, so saves are in the file manager and backups.
script.code:
setlocal EnableExtensions EnableDelayedExpansion
rem Satisfactory's Windows server saves to the run-as user's LOCALAPPDATA\FactoryGame\Saved\SaveGames.
rem Turn that folder into a junction to the service root's FactoryGame\Saved\SaveGames so the saves show
rem up in the file manager and in backups. Runs impersonated as the service user before every start - it
rem owns both folders, so nothing runs with elevated rights. The profile only exists after the first
rem start, so a run before that is a no-op. LOCALAPPDATA is not the service user's in this process,
rem hence the registry lookup. TCAdmin runs this code inside a parenthesised block: variables set here
rem must be read with !delayed! expansion.
set "SID="
for /f "tokens=2 delims=," %%S in ('whoami /user /fo csv /nh') do set "SID=%%~S"
if not defined SID exit /b 0
set "PROFILEDIR="
for /f "tokens=2,*" %%A in ('reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList\!SID!" /v ProfileImagePath 2^>nul ^| findstr /i ProfileImagePath') do set "PROFILEDIR=%%B"
if not defined PROFILEDIR exit /b 0
call set "PROFILEDIR=!PROFILEDIR!"
if not exist "!PROFILEDIR!\AppData\Local\" exit /b 0

set "SAVEPARENT=!PROFILEDIR!\AppData\Local\FactoryGame\Saved"
set "SRC=!SAVEPARENT!\SaveGames"
set "DST=%ThisService_RootDirectory%\FactoryGame\Saved\SaveGames"
if not exist "!DST!\" mkdir "!DST!" || exit /b 1

rem A junction from an earlier start: rmdir removes only the link, never its target.
dir /a:l /b "!SAVEPARENT!" 2>nul | findstr /x /i "SaveGames" >nul && rmdir "!SRC!"

rem Saves written before the junction existed move into the service root. Nothing is overwritten:
rem leftovers that clash with an existing file are set aside in the profile.
if exist "!SRC!\" (
  robocopy "!SRC!" "!DST!" /E /MOVE /XJ /XC /XN /XO /R:0 /W:0 /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP >nul
  if exist "!SRC!\" ren "!SRC!" "SaveGames.unmerged.!RANDOM!"
)

if not exist "!SAVEPARENT!\" mkdir "!SAVEPARENT!" || exit /b 1
mklink /J "!SRC!" "!DST!"
